name: claude-video-studio
description: The video toolkit for Claude: a routing director, a local ffmpeg editing MCP, a shared QA loop, plus the best open-source video plugins installed from their own upstream repos.

plugins.name: video-studio
plugins.description: Director skill + ffmpeg editing MCP (cut, jump-cut, captions, music ducking, reframe, loudness, platform export) + QA loop.

plugins.name: brag
plugins.description: Upstream (MIT, Shunit Haviv Hakimi): turn a project or URL into a launch video. Provides /brag and /brag-slim.

plugins.name: hyperframes
plugins.description: Upstream (Apache-2.0, HeyGen): write HTML, render video. Compositions, GSAP, captions, voiceovers.

plugins.name: watch
plugins.description: Upstream (MIT, bradautomates): let Claude watch a video via timestamped frames and transcripts.
